The search didn't return a complete winners table itself, but it did surface several sources that list the winners from 1969 onward.

- **Official-style lists:** thebookerprizes.com says it offers a definitive list of the winning, shortlisted and longlisted authors alongside their novels, since the prize's inception.
- **Wikipedia:** The "List of winners and nominated authors of the Booker Prize" page covers winners and shortlisted authors (the following is a list of winners and shortlisted authors).
- **Full 1969–2025 list:** Bookshop.org's list runs in reverse chronological order - from the most recent 2025 winner back to the very first in 1969.
- **Ties:** Two sources note exceptions. One says in 2019, Booker Prize judges disregarded the rule against ties, naming Margaret Atwood's The Testaments and Bernardine Evaristo's Girl, Woman, Other. Another source notes that the 1992 award was shared.
- **Special awards:** In 2018 a special "Golden Booker" was awarded celebrating 50 years of the award; this was won by Michael Ondaatje for The English Patient. In 1993, the "Booker of Bookers" went to Midnight's Children.

Some blog lists are out of date. One covers only through 2024, and another stops at 2023, so the Booker Prize's own site or Wikipedia is the better source for a complete, current list.

The search didn't return a complete, reliable year-by-year list. Most results were spam pages with repeated "printable list" text, and none came from the Pulitzer Prizes site.

- **Naming and history:** One result says this award replaced the pulitzer prize for the novel (given from 1918 to 1947). Another says in 1948 the title of the award was changed to the Pulitzer Prize for Fiction.
- **Years with no award:** One source lists no award given in 1920, 1941, 1946, 1957, 1964, 1971, 1977, or 2012. A different source says there have been 11 years during which no title received the award. That count doesn't match the eight years listed, so I'd check it against the official site.
- **Multiple winners:** One result notes two awards were given in 2023.
- **Sample titles:** Some results name early winners, such as 1918 His Family, Ernest Poole; 1919 The Magnificent Ambersons, Booth Tarkington. These are not verified against an authoritative source.

For the full, authoritative list of winners and finalists by year, the official Pulitzer Prizes website (pulitzer.org) is the best source. Its winners database is the one these lists point back to.
